reviewer_statement: Developer-side frozen Python 1.2 scientific declarative-output review of expand_functional_simulation_scenarios. Source-based R revalidation and 13 proposed typed Python 1.2 source comparisons across both contracts test complete JSON mappings, original factor order, scenario grids and seed pairing. Native R S3/list semantic counterpart is used, not Python dataclass/MappingProxyType object identity. Exact-head Python/OS CI has not yet passed; independent source certification has not been provided.
native_language_semantic_policy: Frozen Python dataclass declaration/Mapping/tuple/ndarray/Path/pandas.Index sources are mapped to explicitly validated native R scientific list/S3, matrix and path-string representations, retaining source JSON-compatible primitive semantics and ordering; no Python is invoked by native R.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 src/eyetrajectoriespy/simulate.py entrypoint signature and typed scientific declaration schema, mapped to native R validated S3/list record semantics.

Five typed Python dataclass configuration cases (empty/one/multi-step, nested ndarray/Index/Path and decision provenance), plus 8 fully paired Cartesian simulation matrices across four factor families and shared/disjoint seeds; representable native R scientific object domains only.

Thirteen proposed direct frozen Python 1.2 source-vs-native R full-output cases, comparing every JSON mapping value and every 23-column scenario frame value, source slug, factor enumeration order and exact integer seed policies.

Native R rechecks mutable S3 scenario and preprocessing plan metadata to match Python frozen-constructor invariants; rejects duplicate/invalid factors, invalid source records, nonfinite parameter payloads and seed block overflow. Python TypeError identity and unbounded bigint domain explicitly excluded.

Python dict maps to ordered named native R list, original dataclass tuple to native ordered S3 record list, complete source 23-column pandas scenario table to native R data.frame preserving value/JSON text and nullable scientific provenance.

Cartesian factor expansion of frozen validated simulation scenario declarations, Python source suffix slug/order, stable factor levels and deterministic shared vs disjoint seed pairing, including irregular timing, student-t distribution and correlated multichannel measurement noise.

independent_review_status: Developer-reviewed source semantic candidate; direct Python 1.2 and Linux/macOS/Windows CI pending; 0 independent certifications.
language_specific_limits: Native R S3/list/matrix/path-string is not Python frozen dataclass, pandas.Index, numpy.ndarray, pathlib.Path, or Python mapping runtime identity
Python arbitrary custom __iter__/__str__, unbounded positive integers and exception classes are language-specific and outside native R representable scientific records
These contracts declare/report parameters; they do not imply simulation RNG, scientific estimator, or external artifact export parity

Strict nonempty nested key/order, numerical, error, and semantic tests are unchanged.
